subject: Request: CardioSys bespoke onramp discount & VPC packaging exception
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CardioSys bespoke onramp discount & VPC packaging exception

Team —

Quick ask: CardioSys (Ben Hsu / Alice Chen) is asking for a bespoke onramp package to win a three-month, multi-hospital pilot that could convert to a 24-month committed contract if the pilot metrics look good. Highlights:
- Pilot: 3 months, estimated 6M tokens/month across 8 hospitals (high avg seq).
- Required delivery: Private deployment (VPC) + Dedicated capacity for compliance reasons.
- Commercial ask: 45% off list for first 6 months (blended to 30% after month 6), waived onboarding fee, and a one-time data-migration credit.

Why this matters: CardioSys is a strategic prospect in the cardiac imaging vertical — their product roadmap ties directly to our private deployment offering and could lead to >$2M ARR within 18 months if they adopt multi-region dedicated pools. They have an existing relationship with a systems integrator who has already committed to a POC.

Request: Need VP/CFO-level signoff for an exception to standard starter discounts and a packaging carveout for VPC + Dedicated. Numbers are attached (CardioSys_Rate_Sheet_v1.pdf & MVP-MAP-CardioSys.xlsx).

Proposed guardrails if approved:
1) 6-month minimum committed spend floor: $180k (to protect unit economics).
2) Usage overage pricing reverts to standard list after pilot.
3) Security onboarding milestone (SOC docs) must complete within first 30 days or discount clawback applies.
4) Contract to include rollback to hosted model at a pre-agreed rate if Dedicated ops exceed 120% of forecast.

I've outlined a short memo and a draft term sheet for legal to pick up (term_sheet_cardiosys_draft.docx). Please let me know if you'd like a short one-pager for the exec packet; I can produce it by end of day.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Attachments: CardioSys_Rate_Sheet_v1.pdf (pdf), MVP-MAP-CardioSys.xlsx (spreadsheet), term_sheet_cardiosys_draft.docx (docx)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: CardioSys bespoke onramp discount & VPC packaging exception

Marissa —

Thanks for the note and materials. A couple of immediate questions before I can even brief Finance:

1) Margin / unit economics: can you provide the expected blended cost per token for the pilot (including Dedicated infra and expected support hours)? The 45% ask is well outside our standard starters for VPC deployments.
2) Precedent: Have we previously provided similar packaging for any enterprise prospect (I want to understand the precedent risk and potential cascade)?
3) Escrow/clawback mechanics: the security milestone and minimum spend are good starts — I need the exact language and timing for the clawback (percent and trigger).
4) Contract length / auto renew terms post-pilot.

If you can send the above by EOD I will flag this for an expedited CFO signoff path. Otherwise we should consider a staged approval (conditional approval for pilot only up to X capacity).

Markus
Markus Klein | VP Finance (Interim CFO) | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@cardiosys.com>, Ben Hsu <ben.hsu@cardiosys.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@cardiosys.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: CardioSys bespoke onramp discount & VPC packaging exception

Markus —

Appreciate the quick read. Answers below and attached a short economics table (also in the Drive link):

1) Blended cost: Estimated token cost + Dedicated infra amortized = ~$0.0016 per token for pilot volumes (includes support band and reserved GPU amortization). At 6M tokens/month, gross margin at 45% off list would be ~22% for months 1-3, improving to ~34% after month 6 with the blended step-down.

2) Precedent: We provided a one-off VPC packaging discount last year to HelixBio for a confined pilot (30% off for 90 days) with very strict minimums; CardioSys is larger and the ask is heavier. I note HelixBio required no dedicated capacity and less security work — so not a direct analog.

3) Clawback mechanics (proposed language): If CardioSys fails to complete security onboarding (SOC / IP allowlist / KMS integration) within 30 days of contract signing, Redwood reserves the right to recoup the difference between the offered pilot price and standard list for months where noncompliance persists (prorated). Also propose a one-time cancellation fee equal to 25% of remaining committed minimum to discourage early termination.

4) Post-pilot: If both parties agree, conversion to a 24-month committed license at a negotiated rate (not the pilot discounted rate) with a three-month notice to opt-out prior to conversion.

Alternative mitigations I can offer if full discount is a blocker:
- Reduce initial discount to 35% for months 1-3 with a step to 25% months 4-6.
- Cap dedicated pool to a fixed vGPU footprint (we own capacity risk above that).
- Require a shorter SLA for pilot (30% lower availability SLA) during pilot window if they accept a lower price.

Requested ask: Conditional CFO signoff to proceed with a 35% pilot discount and the guardrails above, OR full 45% only with explicit VP approval from Finance + a signed cancellation/clawback clause.

Alice/Ben — please flag any commercial redlines that would block these guardrails.

Thanks,
Marissa
Attachments: CardioSys_Rate_Sheet_v1.pdf, MVP-MAP-CardioSys.xlsx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CardioSys bespoke onramp discount & VPC packaging exception

Folks —

Thanks for the analysis and the fallback options. I reviewed the economics briefly with Rev Ops and we should be okay to approve a staged approach with conditions. Approvals:

1) Conditional approval for a pilot discount up to 35% for the first 3 months (with immediate step to 25% months 4-6) contingent on:
   - $180k committed minimum for the 6-month window (enforceable).
   - Completion of SOC checklist and KMS integration within 30 days, otherwise automatic price reversion and prorated clawback.
   - A capped dedicated vGPU footprint defined in the SOW (Redwood takes overage risk beyond the cap).

2) Full 45% only if Finance (Markus) signs off after a finalized economic sensitivity showing break-even scenarios and Legal redlines the term_sheet (Contracts team to prepare).

Jordan — please coordinate with Legal on the SOW language and ensure the clawback language is binding. Markus — please confirm the finance memo that outlines the margin impact and break-even sensitivity; I want that in the exec packet. Marissa — prepare a 1-page executive summary for my review by COB today so I can sign the conditional approval and forward to Ben/Alice.

Aditya Rao | Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
